sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 2). Honey is antibacterial. Sugar packs wounds. Yarrow stops bleeding. The old ways work.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
📖 LEARNED: Anatomy (Level 2). Pressure points: brachial, femoral, carotid. You can stop bleeding or drop someone with a thumb.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Surgical Grace! You heal like a surgeon with infinite tools. Critical heals. (Your knowledge of Anatomy amplifies your field_medicine.)
📖 LEARNED: Grave Robber (Level 2). The dead don't mind. Much.
📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 4 skills from your past — check your Journal.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Otis Patel. Mortician. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Brass Locket, Carpenter's square, Photo album, Coat button, Dispatcher's headset. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night, s
A woman, maybe 40s: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
You tell the others you're heading out. Someone nods. "Come back before dark."
— DAY 1 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 19L left.
A person, maybe 60s, with a buzz cut looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 60s, with a buzz cut heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
A woman, maybe 60s, with grey-streaked hair heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
A woman, maybe 40s heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
A man, maybe 20s, with calloused knuckles heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
A woman, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
A man, maybe 60s heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
A woman, maybe 50s heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
A man, maybe 40s heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A person, maybe 60s, with a buzz cut looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
📋 A man, maybe 20s, with calloused knuckles wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A person, maybe 60s, with a buzz cut shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with a buzz cut returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 60s, with grey-streaked hair returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 40s returns with water: +3 clean.
A person, maybe 30s heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
💧 A woman, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes returns with water: +2 clean.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
Night settles. The fire is the whole world now. No watches posted. The dark feels bigger than it should.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
💧 A man, maybe 20s, with calloused knuckles returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 60s returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 50s returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 40s returns with water: +2 clean.

"Hey." A woman, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A woman, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A person, maybe 30s is showing A person, maybe 50s how to tie a snare. Hands patient. It takes three tries.
A woman, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
A person, maybe 60s, with a buzz cut came back with 328 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Akua and Carol lingered over the fire together.

sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 1 skill from your past — check your Journal.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Peyton Ye. Postal worker. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Dog tags, Dead Phone, Boot stone, Dispatcher's headset, Unnamed photograph. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. The stars are wr
A woman, maybe 20s: "Don't bother picking around the tents. Walk out. The land feeds people who go looking."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
You tell the others you're heading out. Someone nods. "Come back before dark."
— DAY 1 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 24L left.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 30s says. (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 60s heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
A man, maybe 50s, with a missing fingertip heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
A man, maybe 50s, with a gap-toothed grin heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
A woman, maybe 20s sets out to find A man, maybe 50s, with a gap-toothed grin. "Won't be long."
A man, maybe 60s heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
A woman, maybe 60s heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A person, maybe 30s looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 30s is working the cookpot, tasting, adjusting.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.

A person, maybe 20s is mending something by the door — patient work.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.

Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ A man, maybe 50s, with a missing fingertip catches you eyeing the bark plates — claw-scored, vine-laced. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They talk you through it — wide strips dried flat, laced overlapping like shingles, snug but not tight. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.

"Hey." A person, maybe 60s settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 60s.)
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.

sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 2 skills from your past — check your Journal.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Ming Guerrero. Emergency dispatcher. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Dead Phone, Dispatcher's headset, Field suture kit, Mother's Ring, Father's Whetstone. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is
A man, maybe 60s, with restless hands: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
You tell the others you're heading out. Someone nods. "Come back before dark."
— DAY 1 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 29L left.
A man, maybe 20s, with a farmer's tan looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 20s, with a farmer's tan wanders off. "I want to see what's out there."
A man, maybe 60s, with restless hands heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
A man, maybe 50s heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
A person, maybe 50s, with a wiry build heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
A man, maybe 20s, with a long braid heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
A woman, maybe 40s heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
A man, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
A man, maybe 60s, with a shaved head sets out to find A man, maybe 50s. "Won't be long."
A woman, maybe 30s is feeding the fire one stick at a time, watching the flame take.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A man, maybe 20s, with a farmer's tan looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
📋 A man, maybe 50s wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A man, maybe 20s, with a farmer's tan shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 50s, with a wiry build telling A man, maybe 20s, with a farmer's tan about himself. The retelling is already better than the event.
💧 A man, maybe 60s, with restless hands returns with water: +3 clean.
A person, maybe 50s, with weathered hands heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
💧 A man, maybe 50s returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A person, maybe 50s, with a wiry build returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 20s, with a long braid returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles returns with water: +2 clean.
🍲 A person, maybe 50s, with a wiry build is hunched over their bowl by the fire, eating like it matters.
A woman, maybe 30s is feeding the fire one stick at a time, watching the flame take.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
No watches tonight. Everyone sleeps with one ear open and pretends not to.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 50s telling A person, maybe 50s, with weathered hands about themself. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
💧 A woman, maybe 40s returns with water: +2 clean.
🍲 A woman, maybe 40s is hunched over their bowl by the fire, eating like it matters.

"Hey." A person, maybe 50s, with weathered hands settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 50s, with weathered hands.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A person, maybe 50s, with a wiry build traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
A man, maybe 50s traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Camilla and David lingered over the fire together.
Nino and David lingered over the fire together.
Carlos and Nino lingered over the fire together.
You remember the Crowbar at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
You remember the Flannel Shirt at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Jacob Deng reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
A man, maybe 60s, with restless hands will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 A man, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles — 🎣 Fish. (a natural — good pick) They'll report back by next part.
"Why are YOU giving orders?" A woman, maybe 60s doesn't raise their voice. That's worse.
📋 A man, maybe 20s, with a farmer's tan — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
"Sam," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Sam." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Sam).
"Nino," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Nino." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Nino).
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 50s speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
"Edward," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Edward." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Edward).
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
It's barely dawn. The day is yours — sleep is for later.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
A person, maybe 50s, with weathered hands looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
Equipped Crowbar (melee).
Equipped Flannel Shirt (torso).

🌿 A man, maybe 60s, with restless hands checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~6 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 A man, maybe 60s, with restless hands hauls back 4 wood. The pile grows. (14 logs now.)
💧 A man, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles returns with 10L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
🪨 A man, maybe 20s, with a farmer's tan pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (1 stone now.)
🧭 A man, maybe 20s, with a farmer's tan is back from the north. "It's... different out there. I'll tell you about it." (Ask them what they saw.)
A man, maybe 60s, with restless hands heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
Edward heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
👥 A woman, maybe 30s heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
👥 A man, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles walks out with A woman, maybe 30s. "Nobody walks alone today."
Nino sets out to find A person, maybe 50s, with weathered hands. "Won't be long."
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A man, maybe 20s, with a farmer's tan looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)

You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 60s, with restless hands telling A man, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles about A man, maybe 20s, with a farmer's tan. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
A man, maybe 20s, with a farmer's tan heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
💧 A person, maybe 50s, with weathered hands returns with water: +4 clean.
Sam heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."

sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
📖 LEARNED: Keeping Morale (Level 1). People need small wins. Celebrate the little things. Despair is the real killer.

📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
📖 Your old life taught you things. 5 skills from your past — check your Journal.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Gloria Cui. Esl teacher. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Mixtape, Dispatcher's headset, Dog tags, Field suture kit, Father's Whetstone. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night, so
A person, maybe 30s, with thick glasses: "We've got days of stores, not weeks. The treeline is the pantry now. Learn what's out there."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
You tell the others you're heading out. Someone nods. "Come back before dark."
— DAY 1 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 29L left.
A person, maybe 30s, with a broad frame shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
A woman, maybe 30s walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A person, maybe 40s heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
A person, maybe 30s, with thick glasses heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
A man, maybe 40s, with a long braid heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
A man, maybe 30s heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
A man, maybe 40s, with a missing fingertip heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
A man, maybe 60s sets out to find A person, maybe 30s, with thick glasses. "Won't be long."

📖 the woman in her 40s, with a shaved head is walking the person in their 60s through a twining vine in wet ground with brownish pea-flowers and strings of round tubers underground — leaf, stem, smell, the beginner's tour.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A person, maybe 30s, with a broad frame looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A person, maybe 30s, with a broad frame shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a broad frame heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
💧 A person, maybe 40s returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with thick glasses returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a long braid returns with water: +4 clean.

sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 2). Predators test: they approach, watch, decide. Prey freezes or bolts. Learn which you're looking at.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 1 skill from your past — check your Journal.
This is home ground. You grew up on country like this.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Samuel Lehmann. Zookeeper. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Reading Glasses, Seed packet, Dispatcher's headset, Photo album, Unnamed photograph. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. You he
A woman, maybe 20s: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
You tell the others you're heading out. Someone nods. "Come back before dark."
— DAY 1 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 19L left.
A person, maybe 30s, with a slouched posture looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a slouched posture heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
A woman, maybe 20s heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
A person, maybe 30s, with a long braid heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
A woman, maybe 40s, with a shaved head walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A woman, maybe 50s sets out to find A woman, maybe 20s. "Won't be long."
A man, maybe 20s sets out to find A woman, maybe 20s. "Won't be long."
A man, maybe 50s, with tattooed arms heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
A man, maybe 50s, with a missing fingertip sets out to find A man, maybe 50s, with tattooed arms. "Won't be long."
A person, maybe 30s, with a crooked nose is stirring the pot slow, fishing out a bone to check the meat.
A man, maybe 40s is sweeping the corners out, muttering at the dust.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A person, maybe 30s, with a slouched posture shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A person, maybe 30s, with a slouched posture looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
💧 A woman, maybe 20s returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a long braid returns with water: +3 clean.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
Night settles. The fire is the whole world now. No watches posted. The dark feels bigger than it should.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a slouched posture returns with water: +2 clean.
🚶 A woman, maybe 50s is back — found A woman, maybe 20s.
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with tattooed arms returns with water: +2 clean.
🍲 A woman, maybe 20s is hunched over their bowl by the fire, eating like it matters.
📨 Word came: a quiet hunter wants to join Haven. "Word travels: Haven takes people in. I'm people." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
📓 Journal: a quiet hunter applied remotely.

"Hey." A woman, maybe 40s, with a shaved head settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A woman, maybe 40s, with a shaved head.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A woman, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan is staring into the fire like it owes them answers.
🔍 A crouches over rank-smelling weed with white trumpet flowers and spiny seed pods, studying it a moment before moving on. (1/3 looks)
A man, maybe 20s traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Ella and Zainab lingered over the fire together.
You remember the Hunting spear at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
You remember the Camo Jacket at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Zainab Ezedinma reads the sky: frost tomorrow, cold.
A person, maybe 30s, with a slouched posture will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
A woman, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
📋 A person, maybe 30s, with a slouched posture — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A woman, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
A woman, maybe 20s shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 30s, with a crooked nose says. (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a long braid shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
📋 A woman, maybe 40s, with a shaved head — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A woman, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan folds their arms. "Sure. Your call. For now."
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
"Aidan," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Aidan." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Aidan).
"Maeve," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Maeve." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Maeve).
"Ella," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Ella." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Ella).
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
It's barely dawn. The day is yours — sleep is for later.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
"You haven't earned that yet," Maeve says. (Trust too low.)
Equipped Hunting spear (ranged).
Recipe: Hunting spear (Level 1). You have seen a hunting spear. Longer than a man, stone at the killing end.
Equipped Camo Jacket (torso).
📋 Ella wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."

🌿 A person, maybe 30s, with a slouched posture checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~9 days of fresh on hand… leaves the fish nets standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 A person, maybe 30s, with a slouched posture hauls back 6 wood. The pile grows. (16 logs now.)
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with a shaved head returns with 8L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
A person, maybe 30s, with a slouched posture heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
A woman, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
Ella heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
🚶 A man, maybe 20s is back — found Maeve.

sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.

📖 LEARNED: Bodyguard (Level 1). In the wilds, when a blow is falling on someone beside you, you step into it. Once per fight, an attack meant for your ally lands on you instead. It hurts. That's the job.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 2 skills from your past — check your Journal.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Carmine Giordano. Crossing guard. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Tote Bag, Dispatcher's headset, Busker's harmonica, Photo album, Trail compass. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. The

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Susan Arora. Electrician. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Home key, Notebook, Carpenter's square, Dispatcher's headset, Search locket. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit.
